segments.sn22.153:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn22.153:1.3: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’”ti?
segments.sn22.153:1.4: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn22.153:1.6: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’ti.
segments.sn22.153:1.7: Vedanāya sati … saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa, evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn22.153:1.11: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’ti.
segments.sn22.153:1.12: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.153:1.15: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.153:1.17: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn22.153:1.18: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’”ti?
segments.sn22.153:1.20: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.153:1.25: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.153:1.27: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn22.153:1.28: ‘no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, nābhavissa, na me bhavissatī’”ti?
